basic_info.description: Have it all in the heart of San Francisco! This beautifully renovated two-level home offers 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and a large private yard, directly across from iconic Dolores Park. The open floor plan is highlighted with a striking and enviable kitchen with high-end appliances, custom lighting, abundant storage, and a quartzite topped island perfect for entertaining.    Sunlight pours through a wall of windows in the living and dining areas, framing lush park views. The main level includes three spacious bedrooms, a full bath, a half bath, and generous closets. The lower level showcases a private primary suite with two walk-in closets and a luxurious bath with soaking tub, double sinks, and shower. Step outside to your exclusive flagstone patio and garden oasis, a rarity in condominium living. Additional highlights include a full-size laundry room, one-car garage parking, and a massive 534 square foot private storage room.     With unbeatable location, space, and style, this home offers the very best of city livingrestaurants, shops, and transit just steps away.
